instruction: Provide instructions for locating and installing alternative VLC skins to refresh its interface.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. The task asks about changing VLC's interface skin/theme. While VLC supports custom skins that can be downloaded and applied, verifying that a skin has been successfully applied is infeasible for automated evaluation because: (1) skin changes are purely visual/cosmetic modifications, (2) verification would require visual UI analysis and comparison, (3) there's no simple state-based check that can confirm the active skin without complex image processing.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - VLC skin/theme changes are purely visual modifications that require complex image processing to verify
No state-based verification method exists for VLC skin changes - skins don't produce accessible configuration state that can be programmatically checked
The infeasible() marker function is the appropriate evaluator for this task type
Metadata provides clear and accurate explanation of why automated verification is not feasible
